description: The highest-severity scoring actions in range (the top 12 by severity, rarest first within a weight), one row per action and weight, placed by how often each happened. Each row ends with its severity weight (· 45), which the colour repeats: one colour per weight, from blue for 10 to deep red for 50, listed in the key below the chart. Rarest is on the left, so the top-left corner is rare and high-severity: where to look first. A failed action gets its own row, marked (failed) unless its name already says so; a failed Kibana change scores 40 whatever it changed. Hover a point for how many identities did it and when.

text.expr: length(data('actions')) > 12 ? 'Top 12 of ' + length(data('actions')) + ' scoring actions, by severity, rarest first within a weight' : length(data('actions')) ? (length(data('actions')) == 1 ? '1 scoring action' : length(data('actions')) + ' scoring actions') + ', by severity, rarest first within a weight' : 'No scoring actions for this selection in this time range'

url.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.name IS NULL)) | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL OR event.outcome == "failure" OR event.action IN ("invalidate_apikeys","anonymous_access_denied") OR (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*), ts_min = MIN(@timestamp), ts_max = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.domain, user.name, event.action, scc = elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, event.outcome, service.name, et = MV_CONCAT(event.type, ","), housekeeping = (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL), suite_install = (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND kibana.session.id IS NULL) | EVAL event.type = SPLIT(et, ","), elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change = CASE(scc, "present") | EVAL risk = CASE(housekeeping, 0, event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, event.outcome == "failure", 40, suite_install, 0, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (event.type == "deletion" OR event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | WHERE risk > 0 | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | STATS events = SUM(n), identities = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor), first_ts = MIN(ts_min), last_ts = MAX(ts_max) BY action = event.action, risk, failed = event.outcome == "failure" | EVAL label = CASE(failed AND NOT (action LIKE "*fail*" OR action LIKE "*denied*"), CONCAT(action, " (failed)"), action) | EVAL label = CONCAT(label, " · ", TO_STRING(risk)) | SORT risk DESC, events ASC, label ASC | LIMIT 200

axis.title: Occurrences in range (log scale) · rarer to the left

values.expr: length(data('actions')) ? split(trim((indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|50|') >= 0 ? '50 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|45|') >= 0 ? '45 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|40|') >= 0 ? '40 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|35|') >= 0 ? '35 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|30|') >= 0 ? '30 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|25|') >= 0 ? '25 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|10|') >= 0 ? '10 ' : '')), ' ') : []
